summary: Build a full multi-page website for “The Creator of Side Quests” with a medieval-fantasy premium brand style, responsive/SEO-friendly UI, interactive elements, social link integration, and a full admin-managed platform including e-commerce (Stripe checkout + request-quote flow), portfolio/testimonials management (including user-submitted star reviews), coupons, loyalty points/rewards, a livestream-driven giveaway wheel system, and admin-driven newsletters including birthday-triggered coupons/cards. Admin access is requested to be controlled via a shared passcode gate plus in-app admin permission granting, rather than requiring an Internet Identity principal allowlist.
architectural_notes: Shop supports both Stripe checkout and an alternative request-quote/contact flow on selected products.
Customer login/accounts are needed to track loyalty points and to uniquely identify giveaway entrants by username.
Giveaway winner selection is performed via an admin-controlled random wheel populated from logged-in users.
Fulfillment/shipping options are configurable in admin; current operating mode is local coordination (no shipping) centered on Ashland/Westwood, KY.
Testimonials should support a user-submitted review flow (1–5 stars) in addition to admin management; star styling must match the mossy-green glow theme.
Portfolio management must support both photo and video uploads and a curated “What I have created for the community” subsection.
Admin access requested to use a shared passcode (second factor) to enter the Admin panel, instead of relying on an Internet Identity principal allowlist for initial access.

Admin panel should support granting/revoking admin permissions for other accounts, and must enforce server-side route protection (not just hiding the Admin tab) so direct URL access is blocked without both permission + passcode.
known_issues: User requested unlimited-size photo/video portfolio uploads (“no matter the size/length”); this conflicts with practical storage limits and will require defined max file size/duration or alternative hosting/streaming strategy.

Shared passcode–based Admin access is weaker security than principal allowlisting; requires secure storage (not hard-coded), rate limiting/lockouts, and a recovery/rotation process to mitigate passcode leakage.

existing_features.title: Create a responsive multi-page marketing website for “The Creator of Side Quests” with the following routes/pages and user-facing copy (in English) based on the provided prompt: Home (hero with headline/subheadline/CTAs/quotes), About (bio + vision/mission/emission + quotes), Services (categories + micro-services + “starting at” placeholders + KY guidance + quotes), Shop, Portfolio, Testimonials, Contact (form with specified fields + response-time guidance + quotes), Hours & Policies (hours, payments/quotes, scope/licensing, returns/adjustments, local service area, anti-discrimination + quote). Include CTAs throughout linking to Contact/booking and Shop/Services as specified.

Apply a consistent premium medieval-fantasy visual theme across the entire frontend using deep mossy greens and dark tones, elegant serif + sans-serif typography pairing, subtle textured backgrounds, and tasteful motion (hover effects, smooth transitions, subtle animations) while keeping content energetic, readable, human-centered, and approachable (neurodivergent-chaotic but professional tone). Do not use a blue/purple primary palette.

Implement SEO-friendly structure for the React app: per-route document titles and meta descriptions derived from the page content, semantic headings (one H1 per page), accessible link/button labeling, and a crawlable internal navigation structure.

Add clickable social media integration as icon links (and/or a dedicated section) that can be configured with the creator’s profile URLs, enabling users to click out to message or view content on platforms (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube).

Implement Internet Identity authentication for users (customers) and a protected Admin area. Restrict Admin access to a single admin account (the creator) using an allowlisted Internet Identity principal stored in backend settings.

Create an Admin panel that allows the admin to manage: Portfolio items (including photo upload), Testimonials (create/edit/delete), Shop products (create/edit/delete), pricing, in-stock/out-of-stock toggles, fulfillment options (pickup/dropoff/delivery toggles), and policies (including default “no shipping” stance but configurable).

Build a Shop experience with (a) product browsing and detail views, (b) Stripe checkout for eligible products supporting debit/credit/digital cards, and (c) a per-product “Request quote / Contact to purchase” option that routes users to Contact and/or social links instead of checkout when enabled.

Implement a Contact/Quote request system that persists submissions (from the Contact page and from quote-only product flows) for admin review, including the specified fields (Name, Email, Project Type, Timeline, Budget, Project Description) and optional linkage to a product.

Implement coupon creation and redemption: admin can create digital coupons (code, discount type/value, validity window, usage limits), and users can apply a coupon at checkout (Stripe-enabled products) and/or have coupons awarded as loyalty rewards.

Implement a loyalty points system: users earn points from purchases and other actions (signing up, visiting, sharing), points are tracked per user, and points can be converted into rewards such as coupons/discounts/free gifts/free items after thresholds configured by admin.

Implement a giveaway system oriented around livestreams: any signed-in user can be added as an entrant (by username/identity display), entrants appear on an admin “random wheel”, and the admin can trigger a random spin to select a winner; the system records winners and timestamps.

Implement public Portfolio and Testimonials pages that display the admin-managed content with media (portfolio images), including interactive UI elements (e.g., filters, cards, modal/lightbox viewing for portfolio items) consistent with the site theme.

Support media uploads for admin-managed entities (portfolio images, product images) by storing image blobs in the backend and serving them to the frontend via stable URLs/asset endpoints, with basic limits and graceful error handling.

Add explicit location/service constraints messaging across Shop and relevant pages: highlight Ashland/Westwood area of Kentucky, coordination for drop-off/pickup for physical/custom/in-person jobs, and “no shipping” by default; ensure fulfillment settings and product messaging reflect these constraints.

Add a frontend static asset pipeline for generated brand imagery (logo/hero/background textures/icons) stored under frontend/public/assets/generated and used across the site (header/favicon/hero sections) without routing images through the backend.

Replace the placeholder Admin Products page with a full product management UI that lets the admin list, create, edit, and delete products, including image upload, price, description, category, in-stock toggle, and requires-quote toggle, using the existing backend product APIs and existing admin route protection.

Implement a user-facing testimonial creation flow on the public Testimonials page that allows a signed-in user to click a “Create Testimony” button and submit a 1–5 star review using mossy-green glowing stars (not gold), and ensure testimonials display uses the same mossy-green star styling.

Replace the placeholder Admin Testimonials page with an admin testimonials management UI that lets the admin view, create, edit, and delete testimonials (including rating), using existing backend testimonial APIs and maintaining consistent mossy-green glowing star styling for rating controls.

Replace the placeholder Admin Giveaways page with a giveaway wheel UI for admins that allows selecting an active giveaway, viewing entrants, adding entrants as admin, triggering a random wheel spin animation, selecting a winner, and displaying winner history using the existing backend giveaway APIs.

Replace the placeholder Admin Portfolio page with a portfolio uploader/manager UI for admins that supports uploading portfolio media, setting title/description/category, listing existing portfolio items, and editing/deleting items using the existing backend portfolio and blob-storage APIs; include a category workflow that supports a dedicated “What I have created for the community” grouping.
Add a shared-code gate to all Admin routes so that a signed-in user must enter the shared code "A7F9K2M8Q4R6T1Z5X3LJH9C8" to access any /admin page, even if the user already has admin permissions.
Create an Admin "Access" management page within the admin panel that allows a verified admin (admin permission + shared-code session) to grant and revoke admin access for other accounts.
Update the existing Admin route protection flow to incorporate the shared-code step while preserving the current Internet Identity login requirement and existing admin-permission checks.

new_feature_requests.summary: Multi-page website (Home, About, Services, Shop, Portfolio, Testimonials, Contact, Hours & Policies) with provided copy, CTAs, quotes, and side-quest messaging

Medieval-fantasy premium UI theme (deep mossy greens/dark tones, textured backgrounds, serif/sans typography) with subtle animations, flippable cards, hover effects, smooth transitions, immersive layouts
Fully responsive (desktop/tablet/mobile) and SEO-friendly layout/copy
Clickable social media integration (icons/links to user-provided profiles for messaging/content)
Shop with product listings and Stripe checkout (debit/credit/digital cards), plus per-product option for “request quote/contact to purchase” instead of checkout
Admin panel (single admin account) to manage portfolio items (photo uploads) and testimonials content
Admin panel inventory & product management: prices, photos, in-stock/out-of-stock toggles, fulfillment options (pickup/dropoff/delivery toggles), and configurable policies (no shipping currently)
Coupon system: admin-created digital coupons usable as rewards/discounts
User accounts/login for customers to support loyalty points tracking and giveaway entry identity (username-based)
Loyalty points system: earn points via purchases and other actions (signup/visiting/sharing) with conversion to rewards (coupons/discounts/free gifts/free items after thresholds)
Giveaway system: logged-in usernames added to a random wheel in admin panel; admin triggers wheel spin to randomly select winner; designed for livestream giveaways

Location/service constraints content + logic: Ashland/Westwood, Kentucky focus; coordinate drop-off/pickup for physical/custom/3D-print/Cricut and in-person jobs; no shipping by default but adjustable in admin

Build full Admin UI (“Admin tab”) that centralizes access to all admin features (Shop management, Portfolio management, Testimonials management, Coupons, Giveaways) restricted to the single site-owner account
Product management admin UI: add/edit products with photos, custom prices/descriptions, in-stock/out-of-stock toggle, and fulfillment options (pickup/drop-off/delivery)
Portfolio uploader/admin UI: upload/manage portfolio photos and videos; include a dedicated section “What I have created for the community” for Cricut/3D-print community items
Testimonials user-facing creation flow: users can click “Create Testimony” and submit a 1–5 star review using mossy-green glowing stars (not gold)
Giveaway wheel admin UI: manage entrants and run the random wheel/spin to select winners for livestream giveaways
Newsletter system: admin can create and send newsletters via the website, including one-off birthday coupon/gift-card newsletters targeted to specific accounts
User profile field for birthday and automated birthday experience: site recognizes birthdays and delivers a custom birthday message/card + an admin-configurable coupon (e.g., 50% off next purchase)

Implement shared-passcode–gated Admin access: users must enter shared code to access Admin; within Admin, authorized users can grant/revoke admin permission for other accounts; Admin tab hidden unless user has admin permission; protect Admin routes from direct URL access

Enforce the shared-code gate on the backend (not only in the UI) by adding backend APIs to: (1) verify the shared code for the caller and create a short-lived admin session marker, and (2) require that marker for all admin-only backend operations (in addition to existing admin permission checks). Include basic brute-force protection (per-caller attempt counting + temporary lockout).
